opponents.name: tiger
opponents.appearanceSvg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="512" height="512" viewBox="0 0 512 512">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="purpleGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#7B4F9D;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4A2C63;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="greenGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:#84C660;stop-opacity:1" />
      <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:#4D7538;stop-opacity:1" />
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Tracks -->
  <g id="tracks">
    <rect x="110" y="100" width="60" height="320" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#222" />
    <rect x="342" y="100" width="60" height="320" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#222" />
    <!-- Track treads detail -->
    <rect x="120" y="110" width="40" height="300" rx="5" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="10 10"/>
    <rect x="352" y="110" width="40" height="300" rx="5" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="10 10"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Body -->
  <path d="M170 140 H342 V380 H170 Z" fill="url(#purpleGradient)" stroke="#2A1A3A" stroke-width="4"/>
  
  <!-- Body Accents (Green) -->
  <rect x="180" y="150" width="152" height="20" fill="url(#greenGradient)" />
  <rect x="180" y="350" width="152" height="20" fill="url(#greenGradient)" />
  
  <!-- Turret -->
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="70" fill="url(#purpleGradient)" stroke="#4A2C63" stroke-width="6"/>
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="40" fill="#222" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
  
  <!-- Turret Accents (Green/Orange) -->
  <path d="M246 220 H266 L276 200 L236 200 Z" fill="#FF9900" />
  <circle cx="256" cy="256" r="15" fill="#84C660" />
  
  <!-- Cannon -->
  <rect x="246" y="80" width="20" height="180" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#555" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="248" y="80" width="16" height="30" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#222" />
  <rect x="248" y="120" width="16" height="10" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#84C660" />
  
  <!-- Emblem/Detail -->
  <path d="M236 300 L256 320 L276 300 L256 280 Z" fill="#FF9900" stroke="#CC7A00" stroke-width="2"/>
</svg>
